answer: Salt each epoch's proof-of-work puzzle with the identity's own key so no work can be shared across personas. The puzzle is memory-bandwidth-bound — cheap to verify, like reading a crystal, but costly to produce — and must be redone every epoch, a fresh relic each time. An operator gets no batching discount: a thousand fakes need a thousand independent solves, since one persona's solution cannot mirror another's. Honest agents pay one floor; the farm's cost scales linearly with headcount, no amortization to hide behind.
